name: code-block
useFor: Use to show a response, a request or a snippet someone will read or copy (an answer's JSON with its sources, an API call). Give it a CodeBlockHeader with the file name and a CodeBlockCopyButton, then CodeBlockContent with the code and its language. Pass wrap for long single values. The code fades at an edge (fade-xy) where more lines or columns scroll past it.
constraints: Highlight colors outside the code tokens
source: Mireye docs site spec (DM Mono commands and code in cut-frame windows) and the code tokens in brand/tokens.css
title: Code Block
description: Code in a cut-frame window: a Bone block in the 1px Stone line with the chamfer at the top-left, a Fog head with the file name and a square copy key, DM Mono at 12px with line numbers and a quiet palette theme.
